_comment: Copy to config/teams/<team>.json, fill every REPLACE_… value, set enabled true, open a PR. Ids: channel C…, user group S… (from a raw <!subteam^S…|name> mention), user U…. Validate with: node scripts/config.mjs validate --team <team>

agent1.agentId: REPLACE agent id of a team-owned Agent1 agent (Slack MCP bound, kibana plugin)
agent1.boardId: REPLACE team board id (runs and cost show up there)
agent1.runAs: REPLACE firstname.lastname whose personal Agent1 key runs the task

output.signature: 🤖 automated triage by rota-triage on behalf of @REPLACE-usergroup — a human from the team will follow up; reply here if this is wrong

jira._comment: Phase 6 (Jira handoff). Keep enabled false until the team trusts the analyses. epics: one open epic per ticket kind; the agent-one label hands the ticket to the team's Agent1 board sync rule. epic: quarterly epic by name pattern; epics_legacy: optional static keys per type, used only when no pattern.

epic._comment: One epic per quarter, resolved by name from the alert date: {Q} = 1..4, {YYYY} = year. BUG Q4 2026 now, BUG Q1 2027 from January. The team creates the next quarter epic; onMissing create-epic: when no epic with that exact name exists in the project, the bot creates it (issue type Epic, summary = the name) and files the ticket under it; skip and create-without-epic are the alternatives.
